nom: Centellian24 Madeca Powder Tea Tree AC

avis.texte: I got this to add to my Madeca Cream. It did well with oil absorbstion. I have oily+combination skin. I also noticed it gave an added glow which was a pleasant surprise. It does have a light lingering smell. It's a gentle smell reminiscent of tea moreso than an essential oil. It is not sticky or greasy. Maintains hydration. I like it. It's earned a spot in my routine lineup. I included a pic of same brand items for size reference. Also, a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: It works as a primer before applying makeup.
avis.texte: I've been trying this product and so far it has exceeded my expectations. My skin is oily, and I applied this powder to my skin and it kept the matte effect going for several hours. When applied to the skin, this powder transforms into a kind of cream that blends in when you rub it. You don't need to apply a lot; just a little is enough to spread it over the T-zone. The container is small, but I feel like it will last a long time. After you apply it, wait a few minutes and then continue with your makeup routine.

avis.titre: Korean skin care is so superior to the USA
avis.texte: Love this as this is my first time using a product like this I just mix a little bit of the powder in my daily moisturizer n I swear the tea tree helps keep my skin clear less acne breakouts,the bottle is tiny, but you only need a tiny amount so it does last for a while I’ll definitely repurchase again I love Korean skin care.
I don't know if it works. Haven't seen a difference and it's hard to get the product out and use

I tried this because I have combination skin so whenever I would apply my makeup my face would look oily after a few hours, I read the description and thought to try it, it actually works, I trust this brand, I use other products as my daily skin care routine but this is a must now as my last step before applying makeup and goodbye oily skin, I love the smell and the refreshing sensation once you apply it!
I gave it three stars as I didn’t notice any difference on my skin. Neither for the good or bad, at least it didn’t create an acne problem for me.
Me encanta hacer magia en mi piel cuando lo mezclo con la crema.
Spettacolare insieme alla crema madeca ti lascia la pelle con glow , al quarto giorno inizio a vedere la pelle più distesa

avis.titre: Great for Oily Skin, But the Size Is Small
avis.texte: I’ve been using this for 8 days, and I’m currently in a love-hate relationship. The Love Part: I have oily skin that usually looks like a pepperoni pizza by noon. This powder? It’s a magic eraser. One dab and the grease is gone, my pores are hiding, and my acne actually looks like it’s reconsidering its life choices thanks to the Tea Tree and Hyper-TECA. The Hate Part: Is this 0.21 oz or did I just buy a very expensive sample of air? I’ve been using it for just over a week and I’m already seeing the bottom of the container. At this rate, the powder will disappear faster than my motivation on a Monday morning. Bottom line: If you want your face to look like a filtered K-drama star, get it. But maybe buy two, because this tiny bottle has commitment issues—it won't be staying with you for long! Edit: I owe it an apology. I’ve been using it almost every day for months, and it’s still hanging around. Apparently, I underestimated how little product you actually need. The container may be tiny, but its lifespan is surprisingly impressive. My skepticism ran out before the powder did.

I have several products from this company and all are really high quality. They put out serious skincare with great ingredients and target specific skin concerns. They deserve thoughtful reviews. I’m writing mine a little earlier than I normally would after seeing some confusion about the product and how to use it. This isn’t a complicated product and the instructions for use are in the product description….more than once. They’re also on the product packaging. “About this item: Instant Skin Relief for Troubled Areas. Snowflake-textured powder melts into the skin, helping calm visible blemishes and redness. No Mixing Needed – Apply Directly. Simply tap onto troubled areas—powder melts and adheres smoothly without additional products.” Not I’m not sure why anyone would leave a harsh review on a product without doing the bare minimum of reading the item description or ever trying the product but I guess everyone is different. That said, I like how this product is very targeted allowing you to treat small troubled areas, like the sides of the nose in my case. It is kinda fun how the powder disappears and feels velvety smooth under your fingers as you apply it. It leaves no residue left behind and there’s no drying of the skin but it does seem to reduce redness and might also have a slight blurring effect. Treated areas DO look better even if I don’t know exactly how it’s working. The bottle is very small so I would suggest being careful when “pouring” out the powder for use. The

avis.titre: Great for my oily, irritated T-zone
avis.texte: I had no idea what to expect with this product but I am so pleasantly surprised and impressed. I started using it after I wash my face in the morning. I've been putting it on after using toner (which I skip sometimes) and before I apply a serum. It's a very fine, lightweight powder. I put just a very small amount of it on the bag of my hand and then apply it to my skin with a small makeup brush, like an eyeshadow brush. I put it around the sides of my nose, the center of my chin, and the triangle shaped area on my forehead between my eyes. It absorbs in very quickly by just tapping it with the brush. It has a very slight green color which helps to offset the redness a bit and after it sets, it mattifies kind of like a primer. You can also just dab it on troubled spots like pimples to help them calm down and heal quicker. I love this brand and have used a few of their products. The only thing that disappoints me about this one is that it's such a small amount of product for almost $20. You definitely have to use it sparingly and not like an all-over face product. In one of my pictures I put the product next to a standard size lipstick for reference. They're about the same size. In the other pictures I put some of the powder on the back of my hand and then run a brush over it to blend it in. I used too much! Darn it. Wasted it! But I hope you can see how the skin on my hand looks different/better with the powder applied to it.

Pros Makes pores appear smaller Reduces shine Absorbs and prevents excess oil Reduces redness and pigmentation Silky smooth application and finish Targeted treatment Mostly quality ingredients Cons Contains silicone (dimethicone) which can cause more problems A bit messy, wasteful container I really wish this didn’t contain dimethicone in such a high amount. After years of misery, I found out my skin won’t tolerate any type of buildup like what it causes. Despite the small tube, this should last a long time if you’re careful, making it an ok value.

I wasn't too sure what to expect when I came across the Centellian 24 Madeca Powder. The main points important to me here were that it has tea tree to assist with cooling irritations and acne as well as calming down redness. In addition, it claims to be pore smoothing/reducing and could be used in multiple applications. Plus, it has centella asiatica, which has been an ultimate add to my skincare routine in the past couple of years, due to it's hydration, soothing, anti-aging qualities, and support in helping create a strong skin barrier. All together, these ingredients are known for their ability to reduce redness, improve elasticity, and promote a healthy, glowing complexion. For someone with very oily, melanated skin and large pores, those are major claims. So far, I've used this alone as a powder, the applicator is hit or miss and I find it's easier to manage with a cushion makeup sponge without losing too much product as it melts right into the skin. The effects of this is similar to a very popular cica cream I've used in the past, where it just neutralizes redness and helps soothe those selected areas of the face. If anything, it leaves a smooth, satin finish, that's slightly different from that you would get from a Dimethicone based solution. In addition, I've mixed it in with a light, gel moisturizer and it pairs nicely without leaving any residue once dried down. Overall, this is a fun product and I can't wait to discover more ways I can use this,

This is an interesting product. I used it on my pores around my nose after trying it on the back of my hand to get the hang of how it works. It’s simple to apply—you just gently tap a little bit of the product out of the bottle onto the ‘problem spots’ that you want to heal. It comes out like a powder and has a sort of cooling effect right away. Then, simply rub it in and the powder disappears and feels a bit like a cool lotion being spread on the spot. My daughter and I noticed that it smells a little like menthol or a vapor rub product—not an overwhelming or obnoxious smell—just a light scent. I didn’t notice an immediate reaction to the product on my pores, but I suspect it would take longer to really do its magic. It’s a pricey product for the size—and I think it’d be easy to use up quickly, so it needs to be used sparingly only on the worst troubled spots.

The concept and ingredients seem cool, but application is a little annoying and messy. No instruction on how to use exactly, so I just flipped it over on my index finger and dabbed/rubbed a small amount on acne's spots and around my nose where I have larger pores. I know tea tree works, but I think I might prefer it in an oil based than this melting powder.

Step 3 of the instructions were not clear so I only did step 1 and 2 as I did not have the other two items. It was a very interesting way to control sebum. The powder is very light and dissolves quickly into the skin. I did notice less oil on oily parts of my face. I can't wait to see its effect on my pores.

This Centellian "24 Madeca Powder Tea Tree AC" is absolutely fascinating! It is exactly how they describe. It comes out as light white powder, but the instant it hits your skin it liquifies, turns clear, and absorbs into your skin rapidly with just a light touch of it with your finger. What this means for application, is that you have to lightly shake it right onto the spot you want to apply it. They have a small pointed open hole for you to tap it out that way, onto your face, but my one issue with this it that sometimes that can be a bit imprecise- it sometimes falls higher or lower than you intended. That would not be a big deal, except for the fact that this is a pretty small bottle of powder. You do not want to waste any with any mistakes. The product itself I love. It seems to give an instant "blurring effect" and I do think my pores look better after using it. Both instantly, and after using it for a few days. It seems effective to me. It has a great feel to it also on your skin, it has a minty "cooling" feel to it that I love. I would definitely get this again, I do wish it was a more forgiving and lasting amount.

I was confused on how to use this at first, because the box mentioned mixing with a toner that wasn’t sold with the powder and I consequentially didn’t have. But I decided to trust the process lol and put the powder straight onto my skin. I was surprised to see the powder melt into my skin - it formed a very light cream. It feels cool and refreshing and is super easy to apply. Virtually mess free as long as you either apply to your hands first or tilt your head back a little. I can’t say for sure but I feel like my skin has felt smoother in the past week or so, and I’ve been using it daily since it’s so simple - no water or anything else needed. Excited to try more from this brand!

I was very intrigued when I stumbled upon this product, and I personally had never used skincare with ingredients like Madeca Powder and Tea Tree. This product seems innovative as it's a powder to cream formula that melts into your skin and is said to target sebum and pores. I love how the key ingredients are TECA (Centella Asiatica Extract) and Tea Tree Oil, which are helpful in calming blemishes and redness. I appreciate the simplicity of this product: after cleansing, you just apply the powder directly to any areas. It feels very soothing, and my skin loves it so far. I think continuous use would be ideal to see the best results. I also love that it's super compact and very small, so you really only need a little bit of powder to address your skin needs!

avis.titre: Spot-On Solution in a Sleek Package
avis.texte: The Madeca Powder Tea Tree AC from Centellian24 offers a refreshingly unique approach to acne and pore care. This finely milled powder transforms upon contact with the skin into a lightweight coating that targets blemishes with precision. It’s designed to absorb excess oil while delivering calming, blemish-fighting ingredients directly to problem areas. I applied a small amount to my fingertip and gently massaged it into an active spot—noticeably clearer in just over a day. The portability of this product is a standout feature: housed in a sleek metal case with a fine-tip dispenser, it makes spot-treatment both tidy and travel-friendly. Its versatility impressed me. Whether used alone or layered under other products, it integrates seamlessly into my routine and delivers effective results without irritation. For those looking to tackle breakouts swiftly without heavy formulas, this little powder packs a punch.

avis.titre: Hidden gem 💎 like a baby powder
avis.texte: I really like all products from this reputable Korean skincare brand, and this acne and pore care powder is no exception. It’s definitely a unique product because of its powder form.. almost like dusting powdered green tea onto your skin. However, it dissolves quickly and absorbs fast, leaving the skin with a smooth, dry finish that almost feels like applying a light foundation. I was pleasantly surprised by how soothing it felt, and I noticed a visible reduction in the appearance of my pores after use. It’s an innovative and effective product, and I highly recommend it for anyone looking to refine pores while calming irritated skin.

This is actually really cool stuff. It really does melt right into your skin, leaving it feeling moisturized while having a blurring, mattifying effect. The package notes that it contains AHA/BHA ingredients that can increase sensitivity to the sun, so do wear protection. The tea tree oil gives the powder a pleasant mild herbal fragrance, which disappears quickly. As always, you can’t go wrong with Korean skincare products. This is no exception.
Powder to cream formula that gently melts on skin to target sebum and pores. Super softly milled and makes a matte finish on skin.
Arrived as pictured. Shipping was great. A product new to me so I wanted to try it. Easy to use and very soothing. Not much needed. Priced very fair.

avis.titre: Very messy and it's a bit grainy
avis.texte: I love the new concept of eco-friendly, powder-based, or concentrated skincare products. They’re often made with cleaner, more sustainable formulas and are better for the environment. I’ve used a powder-based serum before and really liked it, so I was excited to try this one. The serum came in a smaller container than I expected. I poured a small mound of the powder into my hand. It had a pleasant tea tree scent and a very fine, well-milled texture. However, it was a bit messy to handle; even without any wind, some of the powder scattered and flew away. When I rubbed the powder into my palm with my finger, it magically transformed into a cream. The texture was slightly gritty and didn’t spread well on my face. It left my skin feeling tight and wasn’t very moisturizing. I also found that I needed to use quite a bit of powder to get full coverage, which made the product feel less efficient. The instructions were not in English, so I wasn’t sure if it was meant to be mixed with another product. I used it on its own, and while it didn’t irritate my skin, it also didn’t provide much benefit. I may try mixing it with another cream to see if that improves the experience, but on its own, this product just didn’t work for me.
